verdict.rationale: Device attestation at registration is a fair question for a hardware security key, so the axis applies. However, the pack gives no evidence of FIDO2/WebAuthn attestation certificates, AAGUIDs, metadata-service entries, or any way to enforce approved models at enrollment; the FIDO2 docs item is only a page title. The one attestation mention (comm-2) concerns Nitrokey HSM key-attestation certs reachable only through a vendor shell in a non-standard format, which is not registration-time model enforcement.
